description:
DebugStick

Java Edition Style Debug Stick for PowerNukkitX

English | 日本語

Change block states with just a click
Standalone • Lightweight • English / Japanese

Download • Features • Usage • Configuration

--- ## Overview **DebugStick** brings the Java Edition `debug_stick` to **PowerNukkitX**. Change block properties such as stair facing, slab halves and fence connections with just a click, no GUI needed. ## Features * **Property Selection:** Left click to select a property. The selection is stored on the stick and carries over to other blocks. * **Value Cycling:** Right click to cycle the value. Sneak to cycle in reverse. * **Free Connections:** Blocks are changed without block updates, so fence and wall connections can be set freely. * **Keeps Contents:** Chest contents and sign text are kept when changing a block's state. * **Access Control:** Choose who can use the stick: operators only (default), anyone in creative mode, or everyone. * **Protection Friendly:** Clicks cancelled by other plugins are ignored, so it works alongside land protection plugins. * **Standalone:** No dependencies other than PowerNukkitX itself. * **English / Japanese:** English by default. Switch to Japanese or each player's game language in the config, or add your own language file. ## Installation 1. Download `DebugStick-1.0.0.jar` from the [releases page](https://github.com/Byakkono/DebugStick/releases). 2. Place the file into your server's `plugins` folder. 3. Restart your PowerNukkitX server. ## Usage 1. Run `/debugstick` to get the stick. By default only operators can use it (see [Access](#access)). 2. Click a block while holding the stick. | Action | Effect | | :--- | :--- | | Left click | Select a property | | Right click | Cycle the value of the selected property | | Sneak + click | Cycle in reverse | > [!NOTE] > The stick does nothing where another plugin, such as land protection, cancels the click. There is no direct integration with any specific plugin. ## Commands & Permissions | Command | Description | Permission | Default | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/debugstick` | Get a debug stick | `debugstick.use` (only when `access: op`) | OP | ## Configuration ### Access Choose who can use the debug stick with `access` in `plugins/DebugStick/config.yml`. ```yaml access: op ``` | Value | Who can use it | | :--- | :--- | | `op` | Players with the `debugstick.use` permission. Operators have it by default (default) | | `creative` | Anyone in creative mode | | `everyone` | Anyone in any game mode | In survival, left click selects a property as soon as you start breaking the block, and the block is not broken. > [!WARNING] > With `everyone`, survival players can change any block state, including crop growth stages. Use it with care on survival servers. ### Language Messages are in English by default. Change `language` in `plugins/DebugStick/config.yml` to switch. ```yaml # en : English (default) # ja : Japanese # auto : each player's game language (falls back to English) language: en ``` | Value | Display | | :--- | :--- | | `en` | English (default) | | `ja` | Japanese | | `auto` | Each player's game language, English if not available | ### Messages Item name, lore and messages are in `plugins/DebugStick/lang/`. Use `&` for color codes. Copy `lang/en.yml` to a new file such as `lang/fr.yml` to add a language. Missing keys fall back to English. ```yaml # lang/en.yml item: name: "&bDebug Stick" lore: - "&7Left click: select property" - "&7Right click: change value" - "&7Sneak to reverse" message: player-only: "This command can only be used in game." creative-only: "&cUse it in creative mode." no-permission: "&cYou do not have permission to use the debug stick." inventory-full: "&cYour inventory is full." ``` ## Requirements * PowerNukkitX 3.0.x * Java 21 ## Development Built with **Maven**. ```bash mvn clean package ``` The jar is created at `target/DebugStick-1.0.0.jar`. ## Contributing Bug reports and suggestions are welcome. Please open an issue or submit a pull request. ## License This project is licensed under the **[MIT License](https://github.com/Byakkono/DebugStick/blob/main/LICENSE)**. ---

Made by Byakkono for the PowerNukkitX Community.
